Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unjustified constraint (“within Lancashire”) and pivoted to Chorley as the “nearest former mill town,” despite prior evidence clearly identifying Bolton as a former mill town near Rivington Hall Barn. This misinterpretation led to chasing Chorley with redundant searches instead of synthesizing the existing, stronger evidence for Bolton, resulting in the wrong conclusion.
